usage_instructions: TOOL SELECTION GUIDE: Use each result's 'call_with' value as the exact variant to call (call_tool_read, call_tool_write, or call_tool_destructive). The route comes from upstream annotations and overrides tool names, descriptions, command wording, and apparent user intent. When no upstream tier annotations exist, call_with preserves the existing read fallback; do not infer a different route from tool names or intent. INTENT TRACKING: Always provide intent_reason (why you're calling this tool) and intent_data_sensitivity (public/internal/private/unknown) to enable activity auditing.
